status_meanings.implemented: fully implemented inside this Skill Tool and runnable through the named command
status_meanings.documented: guidance, detection or partial support is implemented; the remaining judgement or synthesis step is documented in knowledge-readme.md
status_meanings.delegated: requires an external runtime, service or licence that this Skill Tool intentionally does not embed

categories.name: Slide Family and Narrative Layout Design

entries.name: Presentation Package Profiler
entries.description: Inspects slide count, canvas dimensions, aspect ratio, masters, layouts, sections, notes, media, relationships, and package health before any edit.

entries.name: Slide Object Census
entries.description: Counts and classifies placeholders, text boxes, shapes, connectors, tables, charts, media, groups, and hidden objects per slide.

entries.name: Master and Layout Mapper
entries.description: Maps every slide to its master and layout, identifies unused or duplicated layouts, and separates inherited formatting from local overrides.

entries.name: Editable Object Detector
entries.description: Distinguishes native editable objects from flattened screenshots, imported diagrams, and rasterized compositions.

entries.name: Hidden Content Inspector
entries.description: Finds hidden slides, off-canvas objects, invisible text, zero-size objects, covered elements, and content with full transparency.

entries.name: Notes and Metadata Auditor
entries.description: Reviews speaker notes, comments, document properties, author fields, custom XML, revision data, and privacy-sensitive metadata.

entries.name: Embedded Asset Enumerator
entries.description: Lists embedded images, fonts, audio, video, OLE objects, attachments, and external links with file type and usage location.

entries.name: Slide Family Classifier
entries.description: Groups slides into recurring visual families such as title, divider, content, diagram, checklist, media, appendix, and closing slides.

entries.name: Object Naming Normalizer
entries.description: Renames generic objects into stable semantic identifiers so later automation can target elements reliably.

entries.name: Presentation Dependency Scanner
entries.description: Detects linked files, unavailable fonts, external media, broken relationships, unsupported features, and environment-sensitive dependencies.

entries.name: Deck Baseline Snapshot
entries.description: Creates a reproducible pre-edit inventory of structure, geometry, styles, and rendered appearance for later regression comparison.

entries.name: Presentation Intent Boundary Detector
entries.description: Separates audience-facing content from authoring instructions, production notes, placeholders, and template artifacts.

entries.name: Canvas Geometry Reader
entries.description: Reads exact slide width, height, orientation, safe areas, and unit conversions among EMU, points, pixels, and inches.

entries.name: Content Boundary Estimator
entries.description: Computes realistic title, body, footer, and media zones from the actual object distribution on each slide family.

entries.name: Object Coordinate Extractor
entries.description: Reports x, y, width, height, rotation, crop, and transform data for every positioned object.

entries.name: Safe Margin Enforcer
entries.description: Flags and repairs objects too close to trim, screen edges, projector overscan, or footer boundaries.

entries.name: Out-of-Bounds Object Resolver
entries.description: Finds partially or fully off-slide elements and decides whether to restore, crop, archive, or remove them.

entries.name: Coordinate System Converter
entries.description: Converts layout specifications between PowerPoint units, CSS pixels, PDF points, image pixels, and physical dimensions.

entries.name: Relative Placement Resolver
entries.description: Expresses object relationships such as aligned-with, centered-under, attached-to, and spaced-from instead of relying only on absolute coordinates.
entries.note: Relationships are reported as measured edge/gap deltas per pair; they are not stored as attached constraints on the package.

entries.name: Rotation and Transform Auditor
entries.description: Detects unintended rotations, flips, skew-like transforms, and inconsistent orientation among repeated components.

entries.name: Responsive Slide Reflow Planner
entries.description: Recalculates geometry when converting between 4:3, 16:9, portrait, square, or custom canvases.
entries.note: Proportional reflow is implemented (rescale); aspect-changing redesign decisions still need review of the post-rescale audit.

entries.name: Projection Safe-Area Designer
entries.description: Defines practical readable regions for classrooms, conference rooms, livestreams, and recorded presentations.
entries.note: Driven by the viewing profiles (conference-room, classroom, large-stage, desktop-review, print-handout).

entries.name: Pixel-to-Slide Reconstruction
entries.description: Reconstructs editable slide geometry from a reference image while preserving aspect ratio and measurable alignment.
entries.requires: an image layout/OCR model to derive object boxes from a reference image; the suite consumes a neutral JSON model instead

entries.name: Multi-Resolution Layout Tester
entries.description: Evaluates whether layouts remain legible in thumbnails, presenter view, standard projection, and exported images.

entries.name: Font Inventory and Substitution Planner
entries.description: Catalogs theme and explicit fonts, detects missing families, and proposes metric- compatible substitutions.
entries.note: Missing families are proposed replacements from font_fallback_map; installation state on the delivery machine cannot be read.

entries.name: Inherited Formatting Resolver
entries.description: Traces text appearance through theme, master, layout, placeholder, paragraph, and run-level formatting.
entries.note: Reports the run-level explicit vs inherited split; full layout/master chains are not resolved per placeholder.

entries.name: Type Hierarchy Builder
entries.description: Creates a coherent scale for title, subtitle, section, card header, body, caption, annotation, and footer roles.

entries.name: Minimum Type Size Guard
entries.description: Flags text below configurable thresholds for projector, desktop, mobile, print, or accessibility scenarios.

entries.name: Line Length and Wrap Optimizer
entries.description: Balances text-box width, line count, font size, and natural wrapping without forced awkward breaks.

entries.name: Text Box Margin Normalizer
entries.description: Standardizes internal padding by component role and prevents cramped or uneven text placement.
entries.note: Text-frame insets are read and reported; normalizing them across roles is a layout/theme edit that is not automated.

entries.name: Paragraph Rhythm Controller
entries.description: Normalizes line spacing, before-and-after spacing, list spacing, and paragraph density.

entries.name: Bullet Hierarchy Designer
entries.description: Builds clear multilevel bullets with consistent symbols, indentation, hanging alignment, and spacing.

entries.name: Emphasis Consistency Auditor
entries.description: Detects uncontrolled bold, italic, underline, capitalization, color, and size changes within comparable content.

entries.name: Widow and Orphan Preventer
entries.description: Reflows short final lines, isolated headings, and stranded bullets to improve visual balance.
entries.note: Requires real line breaking; the suite flags the risk conditions instead of reflowing paragraphs.

entries.name: Text Overflow and Clipping Repair
entries.description: Finds truncated text, hidden overflow, auto-fit failures, and glyph clipping, then repairs them safely.

entries.name: Multilingual Typography Adapter
entries.description: Selects suitable fonts and spacing for Latin, CJK, Arabic, Hebrew, Indic, and mixed-script presentations.
entries.note: Scripts are detected and font fallbacks proposed; per-script typographic rules are advisory only.

entries.name: Theme Palette Extractor
entries.description: Reads theme color slots, tints, shades, explicit colors, and actual visible color usage.

entries.name: Visible Color Usage Mapper
entries.description: Maps every fill, line, text, chart, and background color to its slide and semantic role.

entries.name: Unused Accent Opportunity Finder
entries.description: Identifies defined theme colors that are unused and evaluates whether restrained use could improve hierarchy.

entries.name: Contrast Compliance Checker
entries.description: Checks text and essential graphical contrast against WCAG-oriented thresholds and presentation viewing conditions.

entries.name: Color Role Tokenizer
entries.description: Defines stable tokens for background, surface, title, body, accent, warning, success, category, and connector roles.
entries.note: Colour usage is reported per role; persisting a token set into the theme is a design decision left to the author.

entries.name: Semantic Color Coding Planner
entries.description: Applies colors only when they consistently encode categories, states, priority, ownership, or sequence.

entries.name: Monochrome Robustness Tester
entries.description: Verifies that hierarchy and meaning survive grayscale printing, low-quality projection, and color-blind viewing.

entries.name: Brand Palette Harmonizer
entries.description: Maps brand colors into a usable slide theme while controlling saturation, contrast, and overuse.
entries.note: Allow-listed brand colours are enforced and drift is collapsed; saturation/contrast rebalancing is advisory.

entries.name: Gradient and Transparency Auditor
entries.description: Detects gradients, transparency, and overlays that reduce readability or render inconsistently.

entries.name: Dark and Light Theme Converter
entries.description: Transforms a deck between light and dark modes while preserving contrast and semantic roles.
entries.note: A light/dark conversion needs design judgement per slide family; the auditor reports what would fail.

entries.name: Color Drift Detector
entries.description: Finds near-duplicate colors caused by manual editing and consolidates them into approved tokens.

entries.name: Warning Color Governance
entries.description: Prevents red, amber, or green from being used decoratively when those colors already communicate status.

entries.name: Shape Inventory Classifier
entries.description: Identifies shape families, geometry, corner style, fill, line, effects, and semantic use.

entries.name: Component Shape Standardizer
entries.description: Normalizes repeated cards, labels, panels, badges, and callouts into consistent component specifications.
entries.note: Alignment/spacing normalization is implemented; full component specification synthesis is not.

entries.name: Connector Endpoint Validator
entries.description: Checks that each connector is visibly and logically attached to the intended source and destination.

entries.name: Arrow Direction Auditor
entries.description: Verifies arrowhead placement and reading direction across process, dependency, and architecture diagrams.
entries.note: Attachment state is verified; arrowhead direction semantics are not inferred.

entries.name: Connector Routing Optimizer
entries.description: Reduces crossings, unnecessary bends, object collisions, and ambiguous paths.
entries.note: Crossings and collisions are reported; automatic re-routing is not performed.

entries.name: Line Style Semantic Mapper
entries.description: Uses solid, dashed, dotted, weighted, or colored lines only when each treatment has an explicit meaning.
entries.note: Line width and colour are inventoried; semantic meaning of dash/weight must be declared by the author.

entries.name: Detached Label Detector
entries.description: Finds connector labels that can drift away from their relationship and proposes anchored alternatives.

entries.name: Header-Body Card Builder
entries.description: Creates reusable editable cards with locked width, header height, padding, typography, fill, and border rules.

entries.name: Shape Effect Simplifier
entries.description: Removes accidental shadows, glows, bevels, reflections, and inconsistent soft edges while preserving intentional depth.

entries.name: Corner Radius Harmonizer
entries.description: Standardizes square, slightly rounded, or pill-shaped corners according to component type.

entries.name: Diagram Grouping Assistant
entries.description: Groups coherent multi-object components without breaking connector behavior or editability.

entries.name: Native Diagram Preservation
entries.description: Avoids flattening when source shapes can remain editable and reconstructs editable forms when needed.
entries.note: Rasterization is detected and flagged; reconstruction of editable forms from a flattened image is out of scope.

entries.name: Alignment Grid Discoverer
entries.description: Infers recurring columns, rows, anchors, baselines, and guide positions from object geometry.

entries.name: Edge and Center Alignment Auditor
entries.description: Finds objects that nearly align but differ by small, visually distracting amounts.

entries.name: Distribution Equalizer
entries.description: Makes repeated horizontal or vertical gaps mathematically and visually consistent.

entries.name: Optical Alignment Corrector
entries.description: Applies small perceptual adjustments for icons, circles, text, and asymmetric shapes after geometric alignment.
entries.note: Geometric near-misses are reported; optical corrections need human judgement.

entries.name: Baseline Alignment Manager
entries.description: Aligns related text and labels to common typographic baselines across cards and columns.

entries.name: Spacing Token Builder
entries.description: Defines standard micro, small, medium, large, and section spacing values for the deck.

entries.name: Component Dimension Normalizer
entries.description: Equalizes the dimensions of repeated components unless content genuinely requires variation.

entries.name: Whitespace Balance Analyzer
entries.description: Evaluates empty-space distribution and distinguishes intentional breathing room from unfinished emptiness.

entries.name: Density Heatmap Generator
entries.description: Measures object count, text volume, occupied area, and visual concentration by slide region.

entries.name: Title Zone Consistency Checker
entries.description: Keeps title positions and title-to-content spacing stable across related layouts.

entries.name: Footer Safe-Zone Manager
entries.description: Creates a consistent protected zone for slide number, source, section, and confidentiality text.

entries.name: Snap-to-System Repair
entries.description: Moves drifting objects onto the nearest approved guide, spacing token, or component boundary.

entries.name: Master Cleanup Specialist
entries.description: Removes redundant masters and preserves only the master structures needed by the deck.
entries.note: Unused/duplicate masters and layouts are reported; deleting masters is destructive and intentionally not automated.

entries.name: Layout Coverage Planner
entries.description: Creates the smallest useful set of layouts needed for all slide families.

entries.name: Placeholder Role Designer
entries.description: Defines correct title, body, media, chart, caption, footer, date, and slide-number placeholders.

entries.name: Local Override Reducer
entries.description: Moves repeated direct formatting into master, layout, theme, or named component rules.

entries.name: Template Artifact Detector
entries.description: Finds visible template instructions, dummy text, sample logos, outdated dates, and forgotten placeholders.

entries.name: Layout Migration Engine
entries.description: Moves slides from inconsistent layouts into standardized layouts without losing content.
entries.note: Migration would move content between layouts; the suite reports the mapping and blockers instead of moving slides.

entries.name: Custom Layout Generator
entries.description: Builds reusable layouts for diagrams, checklists, comparisons, media, dashboards, and appendices.
entries.note: Slides are authored programmatically; authoring new slide-layout parts is not implemented.

entries.name: Master Footer Controller
entries.description: Standardizes page numbers, project labels, confidentiality text, date fields, and footer positioning.

entries.name: Template Version Compatibility Checker
entries.description: Assesses whether a deck can be safely moved between template versions without style or layout loss.

entries.name: Template Locking Strategist
entries.description: Places non-editable branding and background systems on masters while keeping content areas editable.

entries.name: Blank Layout Governance
entries.description: Restricts use of blank layouts when a semantic reusable layout is more maintainable.

entries.name: Template Starter Pack Builder
entries.description: Produces a controlled set of example slides demonstrating every approved layout and component.
entries.note: A starter set is produced from a declarative spec (asset-deck-spec.schema.json) covering title/content/kpi/process families.

entries.category: Slide Family and Narrative Layout Design
entries.name: Title Slide Composer
entries.description: Creates a strong opening using title, subtitle, identity, context, and optional visual without unnecessary clutter.

entries.category: Slide Family and Narrative Layout Design
entries.name: Section Divider Designer
entries.description: Builds dividers that clearly mark a transition and visually belong to the same design system.
entries.note: Divider slides are classified and audited; a dedicated divider builder is not shipped.

entries.category: Slide Family and Narrative Layout Design
entries.name: Agenda and Roadmap Designer
entries.description: Converts a list of sections into a scannable journey with current-location cues.

entries.category: Slide Family and Narrative Layout Design
entries.name: Key Message Slide Designer
entries.description: Centers one claim with supporting evidence and removes competing elements.

entries.category: Slide Family and Narrative Layout Design
entries.name: Comparison Slide Architect
entries.description: Chooses balanced columns, matrices, scorecards, or before-and-after structures for fair comparison.

entries.category: Slide Family and Narrative Layout Design
entries.name: Checklist Slide Refiner
entries.description: Groups checks by meaning, adds status logic where needed, and prevents long undifferentiated bullet lists.

entries.category: Slide Family and Narrative Layout Design
entries.name: Media Slide Framer
entries.description: Creates a deliberate image or video area with caption, source, aspect ratio, and playback expectations.

entries.category: Slide Family and Narrative Layout Design
entries.name: Closing Slide Designer
entries.description: Creates meaningful closure through summary, next action, acknowledgment, contact, or decision request.

entries.category: Slide Family and Narrative Layout Design
entries.name: Appendix Layout Planner
entries.description: Separates supporting detail from the core story while preserving navigation and context.

entries.category: Slide Family and Narrative Layout Design
entries.name: Q-and-A Slide Designer
entries.description: Builds a clean discussion state with appropriate contact, topic, or prompt support.

entries.category: Slide Family and Narrative Layout Design
entries.name: Transition Slide Minimalist
entries.description: Uses a controlled amount of whitespace and context so sparse slides feel intentional rather than empty.

entries.category: Slide Family and Narrative Layout Design
entries.name: Slide Family Consistency Auditor
entries.description: Compares all slides of the same family for geometry, typography, footer, and component consistency.

entries.name: UML Class Diagram Builder
entries.description: Creates editable class, interface, stereotype, field, method, and relationship structures with controlled notation.
entries.requires: a notation-aware diagram builder (UML shapes and layout) that this suite does not implement; only inventory/consistency checks apply

entries.name: UML Sequence Diagram Builder
entries.description: Builds lifelines, activations, calls, returns, loops, alternatives, and annotations with readable spacing.
entries.requires: a sequence-diagram layout engine

entries.name: Component Architecture Diagrammer
entries.description: Visualizes modules, services, interfaces, dependencies, and boundaries with stable semantic styles.
entries.note: Existing architecture diagrams can be audited; building new ones is not automated.

entries.name: Deployment Diagram Designer
entries.description: Maps nodes, environments, networks, services, and deployment relationships.
entries.requires: a deployment-diagram layout engine

entries.name: Entity Relationship Diagrammer
entries.description: Creates entities, attributes, keys, cardinalities, and relationship routing for database presentations.
entries.note: Entity/attribute structure can be audited when present as native shapes/tables; ERD generation is not implemented.

entries.name: State Machine Visualizer
entries.description: Builds states, transitions, triggers, guards, initial states, and terminal states.

entries.name: Data Flow Diagrammer
entries.description: Represents processes, stores, external entities, and directional data movement at controlled detail levels.

entries.name: System Context Diagrammer
entries.description: Shows system boundary, external actors, dependencies, inputs, and outputs at an executive-readable level.

entries.name: Layered Architecture Simplifier
entries.description: Converts dense architecture into progressive layers and audience-specific levels of detail.

entries.name: Diagram Legend Generator
entries.description: Creates concise legends for colors, line styles, symbols, stereotypes, and abbreviations.

entries.name: Diagram Notation Consistency Auditor
entries.description: Checks that a symbol, arrow, line, and label mean the same thing everywhere.
entries.note: Symbol/line/label inventories are compared; full notation semantics are not modelled.

entries.name: Diagram-to-Text Companion Writer
entries.description: Produces a concise accessible text alternative describing the diagram’s structure and reading order.
entries.note: Alt-text is generated from object type and content, not from diagram semantics; the writer must review the result.

entries.name: Linear Process Flow Builder
entries.description: Creates clear left-to-right or top-to-bottom flows with one unmistakable reading direction.

entries.name: Serpentine Flow Validator
entries.description: Checks numbered multi-row flows so row reversals are obvious and correctly connected.

entries.name: Swimlane Process Designer
entries.description: Separates responsibilities by person, team, system, or phase while controlling lane density.

entries.name: Decision Tree Designer
entries.description: Builds decision nodes, labeled branches, outcomes, and fallback paths with minimal crossing.

entries.name: Milestone Timeline Builder
entries.description: Places dated milestones on a proportional or deliberately non-proportional timeline and labels the scale.

entries.name: Roadmap Horizon Planner
entries.description: Organizes now, next, later, quarterly, or release-based plans without implying false precision.

entries.name: Lifecycle Diagram Designer
entries.description: Shows recurring phases, entry points, exits, and feedback loops.

entries.name: Funnel and Stage Visualizer
entries.description: Represents narrowing stages, conversion points, or qualification gates with quantitative honesty.

entries.name: Critical Path Highlighter
entries.description: Emphasizes dependencies and bottlenecks without obscuring the full process.

entries.name: Workflow Exception Mapper
entries.description: Adds alternate, error, retry, and escalation paths without turning the main path unreadable.

entries.name: Step Card Component Builder
entries.description: Creates consistent numbered cards with header, body, optional owner, duration, and output fields.

entries.name: Sequence Ambiguity Detector
entries.description: Flags flows where numbering, arrows, proximity, or spatial direction disagree.

entries.name: Table Readability Optimizer
entries.description: Improves column widths, header contrast, numeric alignment, row spacing, and continuation across slides.

entries.name: Chart Type Selector
entries.description: Chooses bars, lines, dots, areas, scatterplots, distributions, or tables based on the analytical question.
entries.note: Chart structures are audited; the chart-type choice is advisory guidance in knowledge-readme.md.

entries.name: Chart Integrity Auditor
entries.description: Checks scales, baselines, intervals, sorting, labels, aggregation, and visual distortion.
entries.note: Structure, titles, series count and sign mixing are checked; axis scaling and source data need the workbook.

entries.name: Data Label Simplifier
entries.description: Shows the minimum labels needed to communicate the result without clutter.

entries.name: Series Color Coordinator
entries.description: Assigns stable and accessible series colors across multiple charts and slides.

entries.name: Axis and Unit Normalizer
entries.description: Standardizes units, decimal precision, date formats, abbreviations, and axis treatments.

entries.name: Small Multiple Designer
entries.description: Creates comparable repeated charts with shared scales and consistent dimensions.

entries.name: KPI Card Builder
entries.description: Builds metric cards with value, unit, comparison, time basis, status, and source.

entries.name: Dashboard Density Controller
entries.description: Balances metrics, charts, filters, and explanations for presentation rather than application use.

entries.name: Data Source Footnote Manager
entries.description: Adds compact, consistent source and methodology notes without dominating the slide.

entries.name: Uncertainty Visualizer
entries.description: Represents ranges, confidence intervals, scenarios, and missing data rather than implying certainty.

entries.name: Accessible Data Summary Writer
entries.description: Adds a concise verbal summary of the key pattern for audiences who cannot interpret the visual directly.

entries.name: Image Relevance Evaluator
entries.description: Determines whether an image supports comprehension, context, emotion-neutral evidence, or decoration, and removes irrelevant assets.
entries.note: Relevance needs semantic judgement; the suite flags decorative weight and missing purpose signals.

entries.name: Image Quality Inspector
entries.description: Checks pixel dimensions, effective DPI, compression artifacts, blur, noise, and scaling.
entries.note: Pixel dimensions, effective DPI and file size are measured; blur/noise need pixel analysis.

entries.name: Aspect Ratio and Crop Manager
entries.description: Maintains subject integrity and focal point while fitting images into controlled frames.

entries.name: Image Style Harmonizer
entries.description: Aligns photography, illustration, icon, and screenshot treatments across the deck.

entries.name: Background Removal Planner
entries.description: Chooses when transparent cutouts improve composition and when natural backgrounds provide necessary context.

entries.name: Screenshot Annotation Designer
entries.description: Adds readable callouts, highlights, numbered steps, and redactions without obscuring critical interface details.

entries.name: Icon System Curator
entries.description: Uses a consistent icon family, stroke weight, corner treatment, optical size, and semantic meaning.

entries.name: Decorative Asset Restraint Auditor
entries.description: Removes visual assets that consume space without improving understanding.

entries.name: Visual Source and License Recorder
entries.description: Tracks asset source, creator, license, usage rights, and required attribution.
entries.note: Embedded asset inventory is produced; licence and creator fields must be recorded by the team.

entries.name: Image Alt Text Writer
entries.description: Creates concise, purpose-based alternative text without repeating surrounding text.

entries.name: Asset Deduplication Manager
entries.description: Finds repeated or near-identical images and consolidates them without breaking references.

entries.name: Visual Placeholder Resolver
entries.description: Replaces temporary image instructions and empty frames with final assets or intentional final-state treatments.

entries.name: Video Placeholder Finalizer
entries.description: Replaces authoring instructions with an embedded or linked video, poster frame, caption, duration, and fallback.

entries.name: Media Compatibility Checker
entries.description: Checks codec, container, resolution, frame rate, audio format, and target PowerPoint compatibility.
entries.note: Container/extension and placement are checked; codec validation requires ffprobe.

entries.name: Poster Frame Designer
entries.description: Selects or creates a clear representative frame with legible context and optional play cue.

entries.name: Caption and Transcript Integrator
entries.description: Adds synchronized captions when possible and provides a transcript or summary for accessibility.
entries.requires: a caption/transcript file supplied alongside the deck

entries.name: Audio Level Consistency Auditor
entries.description: Checks loudness, clipping, silence, and consistency among embedded clips.
entries.requires: ffmpeg/ffprobe loudness analysis

entries.name: Playback Fallback Planner
entries.description: Provides a local backup, link, screenshot sequence, or transcript when media playback fails.

entries.name: Animation Purpose Auditor
entries.description: Retains animation only when it reveals sequence, focus, change, or causality.

entries.name: Progressive Reveal Designer
entries.description: Stages complex diagrams or lists without changing object positions unpredictably.

entries.name: Transition Consistency Manager
entries.description: Uses transitions sparingly and consistently, with no distracting or incompatible effects.

entries.name: Recorded Presentation Timing Planner
entries.description: Balances slide duration, narration pace, media length, and total runtime.

entries.name: Motion Accessibility Controller
entries.description: Avoids rapid flashing, excessive movement, and motion that cannot be paused or understood statically.

entries.name: Media Package Collector
entries.description: Collects embedded and linked media into a portable delivery package with verified paths.

entries.name: Accessibility Baseline Auditor
entries.description: Reviews reading order, contrast, text size, alt text, captions, table headers, links, and language settings.

entries.name: Reading Order Repair
entries.description: Reorders slide objects so assistive technologies encounter content in a logical sequence.

entries.name: Alternative Text Author
entries.description: Writes useful alt text for informative images, charts, diagrams, and icons while marking decorative objects appropriately.

entries.name: Color Independence Checker
entries.description: Ensures meaning is not communicated by color alone.

entries.name: Accessible Font and Size Advisor
entries.description: Selects readable fonts and sizes for the viewing distance and audience.

entries.name: Link Text Clarity Checker
entries.description: Replaces raw or ambiguous links with descriptive audience-facing text.

entries.name: Table Accessibility Formatter
entries.description: Defines header rows, logical reading order, simple structure, and alternatives for complex tables.

entries.name: Caption and Transcript Auditor
entries.description: Checks audio and video for captions, transcripts, speaker identification, and timing quality.
entries.requires: the media track and a caption file

entries.name: Language and Locale Setter
entries.description: Sets document and text language for proofing, pronunciation, and assistive technology.

entries.name: Cognitive Load Reducer
entries.description: Simplifies dense layouts, unexplained abbreviations, long lists, and competing signals.

entries.name: Accessible Diagram Companion
entries.description: Provides structured text descriptions and legends for complex visual relationships.

entries.name: Accessibility Exception Reporter
entries.description: Documents unavoidable limitations, impact, mitigation, and an accessible alternative.
entries.note: Every report lists the measurement limits that were not checked, which is the exception record.

entries.name: Slide Density Scorer
entries.description: Combines object count, word count, occupied area, type size, and relationship complexity into a practical density signal.

entries.name: Projection Readability Simulator
entries.description: Evaluates text and line visibility at representative room distances and projector quality.

entries.name: One-Message Test
entries.description: Checks whether a viewer can identify the slide’s main claim within a few seconds.

entries.name: Dense Slide Splitter
entries.description: Divides overloaded material into a logical sequence while preserving context and navigation.
entries.note: Splitting is planned and ordered, not executed automatically.

entries.name: Sparse Slide Intent Checker
entries.description: Distinguishes deliberate minimalism from missing content or unfinished placeholders.

entries.name: Abbreviation Load Auditor
entries.description: Finds unexplained acronyms and adds a legend, expansion, or audience- appropriate alternative.

entries.name: Scanning Path Optimizer
entries.description: Arranges title, message, evidence, and action in a predictable visual path.

entries.name: Annotation Priority Manager
entries.description: Limits labels and callouts to the few that materially improve interpretation.

entries.name: Information Chunking Designer
entries.description: Groups related items into meaningful units with visible boundaries and headings.

entries.name: Detail-on-Demand Planner
entries.description: Moves secondary detail to builds, appendix slides, notes, or linked references.

entries.name: Cognitive Friction Detector
entries.description: Flags inconsistent symbols, competing directions, unexplained color, and unnecessary visual decisions.

entries.name: Audience Distance Adapter
entries.description: Creates variants for live projection, desktop review, mobile viewing, and printed handouts.

entries.name: Brand Asset Intake
entries.description: Collects approved logos, fonts, colors, imagery rules, templates, and legal restrictions.
entries.note: Declared in the config 'brand' block and validated against asset-config.schema.json.

entries.name: Logo Placement Controller
entries.description: Standardizes logo size, clear space, contrast, and approved placement.

entries.name: Brand Typography Mapper
entries.description: Maps brand typefaces and fallback fonts to presentation roles and technical constraints.

entries.name: Brand Color Application Planner
entries.description: Allocates brand colors to practical slide roles while preserving readability.

entries.name: Visual Motif Designer
entries.description: Creates a restrained repeatable motif that supports recognition without competing with content.

entries.name: Brand Compliance Auditor
entries.description: Checks each slide for unauthorized colors, fonts, logo treatment, image style, and messaging artifacts.

entries.name: Co-Branding Layout Designer
entries.description: Balances multiple organizations’ identity rules without implying false hierarchy or endorsement.

entries.name: Confidentiality Marking Manager
entries.description: Applies classification, confidentiality, or distribution labels consistently and unobtrusively.

entries.name: Version and Project Badge Designer
entries.description: Creates compact project, release, or status identifiers with controlled placement.

entries.name: Brand Refresh Migrator
entries.description: Updates legacy decks to a new identity while preserving content structure and editable components.
entries.note: Colour and font migration is automated; full identity restyling is not.

entries.name: Neutral Template Generator
entries.description: Creates an identity-light version suitable for external sharing or white-label use.

entries.name: Brand Exception Register
entries.description: Records intentional deviations, justification, approval, and scope.

entries.name: Paragraph-to-Slide Distiller
entries.description: Converts prose into a title, key claim, supporting points, and optional evidence.
entries.requires: a language model for prose distillation

entries.name: Bullet Compression Editor
entries.description: Shortens bullets while preserving meaning, qualifiers, and parallel structure.
entries.note: Over-long bullets are flagged with limits; rewriting stays with the author.

entries.name: Technical-to-Executive Translator
entries.description: Reframes implementation detail into outcomes, risks, decisions, and evidence.
entries.requires: a language model for audience reframing

entries.name: Executive-to-Technical Expander
entries.description: Adds architecture, assumptions, constraints, interfaces, and verification detail for technical audiences.
entries.requires: a language model for technical expansion

entries.name: Slide Title Claim Rewriter
entries.description: Turns topic labels into specific audience-relevant claims when the content supports them.

entries.name: Parallel Structure Normalizer
entries.description: Makes lists and card headings grammatically and conceptually parallel.

entries.name: Terminology Consistency Manager
entries.description: Maintains approved names, capitalization, acronyms, and definitions across the deck.

entries.name: Audience Language Adapter
entries.description: Adjusts vocabulary, context, examples, and explanation depth for a defined audience.
entries.requires: a language model for audience adaptation

entries.name: Speaker Note Composer
entries.description: Moves delivery detail, caveats, and narration into notes without overcrowding the slide.

entries.name: Call-to-Action Writer
entries.description: Creates explicit next steps, owners, timing, and decisions requested.

entries.name: Redundancy Eliminator
entries.description: Finds repeated messages and consolidates or differentiates them.

entries.name: Content-to-Visual Recommender
entries.description: Chooses when content is best represented as text, process, comparison, timeline, table, chart, diagram, or media.

entries.name: Claim Source Mapper
entries.description: Connects factual claims, figures, quotations, and visuals to their supporting sources.

entries.name: Citation Style Normalizer
entries.description: Applies a consistent short-source, footnote, endnote, or appendix citation system.

entries.name: Data Provenance Recorder
entries.description: Captures dataset, owner, extraction date, transformation, version, and calculation basis.

entries.name: Image Attribution Manager
entries.description: Stores creator, source, license, modification status, and required credit language.
entries.note: Asset inventory is produced; creator/licence fields are entered by the team.

entries.name: Source Freshness Checker
entries.description: Flags time-sensitive slides whose sources or data have become stale.

entries.name: Broken Link Auditor
entries.description: Checks linked evidence and identifies inaccessible, redirected, or permission- limited sources.
entries.note: Offline checks cover raw links and domain policy; live reachability requires network access.

entries.name: Quotation Integrity Checker
entries.description: Verifies that quotations are accurately attributed, minimally reproduced, and not misleadingly truncated.

entries.name: Methodology Note Builder
entries.description: Adds concise definitions, assumptions, sample details, and calculation notes for quantitative slides.

entries.name: Evidence Confidence Labeler
entries.description: Distinguishes measured facts, estimates, scenarios, assumptions, and opinions.

entries.name: Reference Appendix Builder
entries.description: Creates an organized source appendix keyed to slide numbers or claim identifiers.

entries.name: Internal Source Privacy Guard
entries.description: Prevents confidential file paths, tenant links, participant data, or private metadata from leaking into external decks.

entries.name: Citation Completeness Auditor
entries.description: Finds claims and visuals that require sourcing but have no attribution.

entries.name: PowerPoint Package Validator
entries.description: Checks the Office package for corrupt relationships, malformed XML, missing parts, and unsupported references.

entries.name: Slide Render Inspector
entries.description: Renders every slide and checks for clipping, overlap, missing fonts, broken media, and unexpected transparency.
entries.note: Rendering is geometry-model based; text metrics are approximate.

entries.name: Visual Regression Comparator
entries.description: Compares before-and-after renders to find unintended movement, deletion, resizing, or restyling.

entries.name: Text Overflow Test
entries.description: Checks every text frame for overflow, clipping, auto-fit side effects, and unreadably reduced type.

entries.name: Overlap and Collision Detector
entries.description: Finds unintended object overlaps while allowing known intentional layering.

entries.name: Out-of-Bounds Test
entries.description: Flags objects and effects extending beyond safe or visible slide bounds.

entries.name: Connector Regression Test
entries.description: Checks that connectors still reach the correct objects after layout changes.

entries.name: Font Fallback Test
entries.description: Renders with the delivery environment’s fonts and identifies substitutions that change spacing or glyphs.

entries.name: Export Parity Checker
entries.description: Compares PowerPoint, PDF, image, and browser-based renders for material differences.
entries.requires: PowerPoint or LibreOffice to produce PDF/image exports for comparison

entries.name: Clean-State Open Test
entries.description: Verifies that the deck opens and functions from a fresh delivery location without local dependencies.
entries.note: Reopens every artifact from the packaged location and re-parses the package.

entries.name: Presentation Mode Walkthrough
entries.description: Tests slide order, transitions, media, hyperlinks, builds, and presenter-view behavior end to end.
entries.requires: PowerPoint presentation-mode playback for transitions, builds and presenter view

entries.name: Defect Triage and Repair Queue
entries.description: Ranks defects by audience impact, frequency, repair risk, and dependency.

entries.name: Last-Known-Good Snapshot Manager
entries.description: Preserves a passing version before each meaningful repair or transformation.

entries.name: Layout Drift Root-Cause Analyzer
entries.description: Separates master, layout, placeholder, local formatting, font, and renderer causes of movement.

entries.name: Broken Connector Repair
entries.description: Reconnects detached lines and restores the intended routing after object changes.

entries.name: Missing Font Recovery
entries.description: Selects and applies compatible replacements while checking reflow and visual identity.

entries.name: Corrupt Media Recovery
entries.description: Re-embeds, converts, replaces, or safely removes media that prevents playback or opening.

entries.name: Package Relationship Repair
entries.description: Repairs missing or invalid internal relationships without discarding unaffected content.
entries.note: Dangling relationships are detected; automatic relinking is not performed.

entries.name: Accidental Flattening Recovery
entries.description: Reconstructs editable text, shapes, and diagrams from flattened references where practical.

entries.name: Style Drift Repair
entries.description: Identifies the earliest inconsistent override and restores the governing style token.

entries.name: Slide Salvage Extractor
entries.description: Recovers usable content from a partially corrupt deck into a clean package.

entries.name: Minimal Change Repair Planner
entries.description: Limits changes to the smallest area responsible for a defect and reruns dependent checks.

entries.name: Batch Repair with Exceptions
entries.description: Applies safe repeated repairs while isolating slides that require individual handling.

entries.name: Repair Verification Harness
entries.description: Rechecks the original failure, normal slides, boundary cases, and visual regressions after repair.
entries.note: After every --apply the repair command reselects the same engines and reports before/after counts.

entries.name: Presentation Object API Wrapper
entries.description: Provides stable functions for reading, creating, moving, styling, and deleting slide objects.
entries.note: The object layer is tools-deckmodel.py; authoring operations live in tools-authoring.py.

entries.name: Style Token Configuration Loader
entries.description: Loads fonts, colors, spacing, borders, radii, and type roles from a reusable configuration.
entries.note: Style/spacing/colour tokens load from asset-default-rules.json plus a user config.

entries.name: Reusable Card Component Generator
entries.description: Creates parameterized header-body cards with predictable geometry and editability.

entries.name: Batch Deck Processor
entries.description: Runs inspection, normalization, rendering, and reporting across many presentations.

entries.name: Rule-Based Slide Linter
entries.description: Evaluates decks against configurable design, accessibility, branding, and production rules.

entries.name: Slide Transformation Pipeline
entries.description: Chains intake, repair, enhancement, validation, and export through explicit intermediate artifacts.

entries.name: Idempotent Formatting Engine
entries.description: Applies formatting repeatedly without compounding changes or drifting geometry.

entries.name: Object Matching Across Versions
entries.description: Matches corresponding objects despite small changes in IDs, position, text, or order.
entries.note: Objects are matched on name plus a text prefix so small ID/order changes do not break the match.

entries.name: Declarative Layout Generator
entries.description: Builds slides from structured content and layout specifications rather than manual coordinates alone.

entries.name: Component Library Registry
entries.description: Catalogs approved slide components, versions, parameters, examples, and compatibility.
entries.note: The declarative deck spec plus the capability registry act as the component library.

entries.name: Automation Exception Reporter
entries.description: Produces actionable error records with slide, object, rule, observed state, and suggested repair.
entries.note: batch.json and repair-changes.json record per-item exceptions with cause.

entries.name: Clean Build Reproducer
entries.description: Recreates a deck from source content and configuration in a fresh environment.

entries.name: PowerPoint-to-PDF Exporter
entries.description: Exports a text-heavy or visual deck to PDF while checking pagination, fonts, links, and media fallbacks.
entries.requires: PowerPoint or LibreOffice to perform the actual PDF export

entries.name: Slide Image Exporter
entries.description: Produces consistent PNG or JPEG slide images at controlled dimensions and quality.
entries.note: Exports PNG/JPEG from the geometry model, not from the PowerPoint renderer.

entries.name: Handout Generator
entries.description: Creates printable multi-slide handouts with readable notes, page numbers, and margins.
entries.note: Contact sheets support review; printable handout layout with notes is not generated.

entries.name: Web Presentation Converter
entries.description: Adapts slide content to browser delivery while preserving hierarchy and accessible alternatives.
entries.requires: an HTML export target; the suite produces reports, not slide-to-HTML conversion

entries.name: Aspect Ratio Conversion Packager
entries.description: Produces alternate 16:9, 4:3, portrait, or social-media variants with controlled reflow.

entries.name: Font Embedding and Subset Planner
entries.description: Determines when fonts can be embedded, replaced, outlined, or packaged legally and technically.
entries.requires: font licence/embedding permission data and a font tool to subset

entries.name: Linked Asset Collector
entries.description: Collects external media and linked files into a portable folder with repaired paths.

entries.name: Delivery Folder Builder
entries.description: Packages final deck, PDF, media, source assets, and readme into a clean recipient- ready structure.

entries.name: Archive and Version Packager
entries.description: Creates deterministic archives with semantic names, version identifiers, and only approved deliverables.

entries.name: Print Preflight Specialist
entries.description: Checks page size, margins, bleed expectations, grayscale behavior, and high- resolution asset needs.

entries.name: File Size Optimizer
entries.description: Reduces image, media, and package size without unacceptable quality or editability loss.

entries.name: Delivery Integrity Checker
entries.description: Reopens every final artifact from the packaged location and verifies that names, paths, and contents are correct.

entries.name: Slide Text Extractor for Translation
entries.description: Extracts text with slide and object context while preserving placeholders and non- translatable tokens.

entries.name: Terminology-Controlled Translator
entries.description: Applies approved terminology, product names, abbreviations, and audience- specific language.
entries.requires: a translation service or language model plus an approved terminology list

entries.name: Text Expansion Reflow Manager
entries.description: Reflows translated content that expands or contracts without reducing type below thresholds.
entries.note: Expansion risk is estimated from the active type size and frame width.

entries.name: Right-to-Left Layout Adapter
entries.description: Mirrors appropriate layout relationships and corrects paragraph direction for RTL languages.

entries.name: CJK Typography Adapter
entries.description: Applies suitable fonts, line breaking, punctuation, and spacing for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

entries.name: Locale Format Converter
entries.description: Adapts dates, times, numbers, units, currencies, decimals, and separators.

entries.name: Multilingual Font Coverage Tester
entries.description: Checks that all required glyphs exist and render consistently in the target environment.
entries.requires: font files or a font-coverage API to test glyph coverage

entries.name: Bilingual Slide Designer
entries.description: Builds balanced dual-language slides without doubling visual clutter.

entries.name: Localized Image Text Reviewer
entries.description: Detects text embedded in images that also requires translation or replacement.
entries.requires: OCR to read text inside images

entries.name: Translation QA Comparator
entries.description: Checks omissions, additions, number mismatches, terminology drift, and layout damage.

entries.name: Cultural Visual Suitability Reviewer
entries.description: Flags symbols, gestures, colors, examples, and imagery that may not transfer appropriately.
entries.requires: a vision model or human cultural review

entries.name: Language Variant Packager
entries.description: Produces separately named verified deliverables for each locale and maintains version parity.

entries.name: Personal Metadata Scrubber
entries.description: Removes author, company, revision, comment, and hidden personal metadata where appropriate.

entries.name: Sensitive Content Scanner
entries.description: Finds credentials, personal data, internal URLs, confidential labels, and unintended disclosures.

entries.name: Hidden Slide Governance
entries.description: Reviews hidden slides before delivery so obsolete or restricted content is not accidentally included.

entries.name: Comment and Note Sanitizer
entries.description: Removes or preserves reviewer comments and speaker notes according to the delivery policy.

entries.name: External Link Policy Checker
entries.description: Classifies and validates links against allowed domains and sharing requirements.

entries.name: Macro and Embedded Object Inspector
entries.description: Detects macros, OLE objects, executables, and risky embedded content.

entries.name: Access Classification Labeler
entries.description: Applies internal, confidential, public, or restricted markings consistently.
entries.note: Existing classification markings are detected and reported; applying new labels is a text edit the author signs off on.

entries.name: Redacted Presentation Producer
entries.description: Creates a verified external version that removes, rather than merely covers, sensitive content.
entries.note: Matches are replaced with [REDACTED] in text frames and notes, then re-scanned to confirm removal.

entries.name: Least-Content Delivery Planner
entries.description: Includes only the slides, notes, media, and source detail required for the recipient.

entries.name: Sharing Permission Reviewer
entries.description: Checks whether linked files and cloud resources are accessible to the intended recipients.
entries.requires: network/Microsoft Graph access to test recipient permissions

entries.name: Retention and Archive Tagger
entries.description: Adds appropriate project, version, owner, date, and retention metadata.

entries.name: Governed Publication Gate
entries.description: Blocks release until privacy, security, accessibility, citation, and final-state checks pass.

entries.name: Requirement Coverage Scorer
entries.description: Maps every requested output and constraint to an observed artifact feature.
entries.note: Deck specs can be compared against observed structure; free-text requirement coverage needs judgement.

entries.name: Readability Scorecard
entries.description: Scores minimum type size, contrast, density, line length, and projection suitability.

entries.name: Consistency Scorecard
entries.description: Scores title, spacing, color, typography, footer, component, and line-system consistency.

entries.name: Accessibility Scorecard
entries.description: Scores reading order, alt text, captions, contrast, language, tables, and link clarity.

entries.name: Maintainability Scorecard
entries.description: Scores editability, component reuse, master usage, object naming, and automation safety.

entries.name: Production Readiness Scorecard
entries.description: Scores final-state completeness, media, citations, instructions, closing treatment, and package integrity.

entries.name: Before-and-After Improvement Evaluator
entries.description: Measures whether a revision improved target dimensions without causing regressions.

entries.name: Audience Task Success Evaluator
entries.description: Tests whether a viewer can identify the message, follow the sequence, and take the requested action.

entries.name: Edge-Case Deck Benchmark
entries.description: Tests empty slides, huge decks, multilingual text, dense diagrams, missing fonts, and broken media.
entries.note: Edge cases are exercised by asset-test-cases.json; run tools-selftest.py to execute them.

entries.name: Repairability Benchmark
entries.description: Measures how quickly and safely common defects can be isolated and corrected.

entries.name: Cross-Renderer Fidelity Benchmark
entries.description: Compares appearance and function across PowerPoint, PDF, image export, and alternate viewers.
entries.requires: PowerPoint, LibreOffice and a second renderer for cross-renderer comparison

entries.name: Evidence-Based Quality Gate
entries.description: Requires observable passing checks rather than relying on subjective confidence alone.

entries.name: Presentation Task Router
entries.description: Routes inspection, design, writing, accessibility, media, coding, and export work to the smallest capable specialist.

entries.name: Dependency-Aware Work Planner
entries.description: Orders tasks so inspection precedes modification, assets precede layout, and validation follows every material change.

entries.name: Thin-Slice Prototype Builder
entries.description: Creates one representative passing slide or component before scaling the treatment across the deck.
entries.note: Authoring one spec slide first and re-auditing it is the supported thin-slice workflow.

entries.name: Parallel Asset Preparation Coordinator
entries.description: Generates independent images, diagrams, data, and copy in parallel before slide assembly.
entries.note: Independent decks and assets can be processed in one batch; parallel generation needs external workers.

entries.name: Change Impact Analyzer
entries.description: Determines which slides, components, exports, and checks must be rerun after a change.

entries.name: Confidence and Escalation Controller
entries.description: Escalates ambiguous, high-risk, or irreversible changes while completing safe work automatically.
entries.note: Appearance-changing operations refuse to run without --approve.

entries.name: Skill Interface Contract Manager
entries.description: Defines exact inputs, outputs, units, names, assumptions, and failure meanings between skills.
entries.note: Contracts are the two shipped schemas plus the neutral deck model documented in knowledge-readme.md.

entries.name: Passing-Spine Preserver
entries.description: Protects the last complete working presentation while new capabilities are added.

entries.name: Exception Isolation Coordinator
entries.description: Separates failing slides or assets so independent passing work can continue.
entries.note: A failing deck is isolated and recorded; the batch continues.

entries.name: Multi-Agent Result Integrator
entries.description: Merges outputs from writing, design, data, media, and QA specialists into one coherent deck.

entries.name: Recipient Effort Minimizer
entries.description: Chooses methods that reduce manual cleanup, missing dependencies, and opening friction for the recipient.

entries.name: Completion Gatekeeper
entries.description: Declares completion only after requested files exist, open correctly, render correctly, and match the packaging specification.

entries.name: Skill Discovery Indexer
entries.description: Indexes skills by trigger, input type, output type, domain, risk, dependencies, and execution cost.

entries.name: Skill Trigger Disambiguator
entries.description: Separates similarly named skills by explicit use cases, exclusions, and precedence rules.
entries.note: Every capability records engines, commands and exclusions so overlapping names stay separable.

entries.name: Skill Capability Gap Finder
entries.description: Compares observed tasks and failures against the existing catalog to identify missing capabilities.

entries.name: Skill Overlap Consolidator
entries.description: Finds duplicate or competing skills and proposes clearer boundaries or shared components.

entries.name: Skill Version Manager
entries.description: Tracks skill versions, compatibility, changed interfaces, migrations, and deprecations.

entries.name: Skill Dependency Mapper
entries.description: Records libraries, tools, templates, models, assets, and connected sources required by each skill.

entries.name: Skill Test Case Generator
entries.description: Creates normal, boundary, failure, repair, and regression cases for each skill.
entries.note: Test cases ship as asset-test-cases.json and run through tools-selftest.py.

entries.name: Skill Quality Benchmark
entries.description: Measures correctness, robustness, editability, runtime, repairability, accessibility, and recipient effort.

entries.name: Skill Documentation Builder
entries.description: Produces concise trigger rules, inputs, outputs, examples, failure modes, and handoff instructions.
entries.note: Documented in knowledge-readme.md.

entries.name: Skill Packaging Auditor
entries.description: Checks directory structure, manifests, entry points, licenses, and clean-state reproducibility.

entries.name: Skill Deprecation Planner
entries.description: Retires weak or redundant skills while preserving migration paths and historical compatibility.

entries.name: Catalog Recommendation Engine
entries.description: Recommends the smallest compatible skill set for a requested outcome without unnecessary orchestration. Implementation Specification Template Use this schema when the stronger catalog-building system converts any catalog entry into a real skill package. 1. Skill name and stable identifier 2. One-sentence purpose 3. Explicit trigger conditions 4. Non-trigger and exclusion conditions 5. Required inputs and accepted formats 6. Produced outputs and file formats 7. Dependencies, tools, templates, and connected sources 8. Execution workflow and checkpoints 9. Validation and acceptance criteria 10. Failure modes, repair actions, and stop conditions 11. Security, privacy, accessibility, and licensing requirements 12. Normal, boundary, failure, repair, and regression tests 13. Examples and counterexamples 14. Version, compatibility, owner, and deprecation policy Catalog Summary Total categories: 27 Total candidate skills: 324 Design intent: preserve editable, testable, repairable presentation workflows while expanding the agent from visual inspection into complete production, governance, and capability management.
